text:
maria: Follow-up from the pm: three mitigation buckets for vendor/dependency outage: auth provider throttles, registry timeouts, storage retry storms. Need owners+deadlines.

jason: I can own vendor liaison + SLA extract. Will escalate to account team and ask for remediation milestones. ETA Tue EOD.

aisha: I'll take registry fallback (read-only + local warm cache) and the rollback play. Will produce a runbook draft and tests by next Mon.

don: I'll do auth hardening: token rotation plan, client-side caching with safe TTLs, and fail-open vs fail-closed matrix. Need Security sign-off. 10 days.

tooling-bot: Epic created: https://tracker/INF-4200 "Dependency resilience: auth+registry". Tasks INF-4201..INF-4205.

maria: Also want recurrence detection: correlate auth latency spikes with model fetch errors. Can we add an alert that pages when both cross thresholds?

don: Yep, I'll add dashboard + an alert: (auth_p95>250ms && model_fetch_errors>1%) sustained 5m -> page. Also a weekly digest to #incidents.

aisha: For cache TTL safety, I'll run a staging replay harness against last month's traces to measure quality drift. Will include TTL knobs.

jason: Recommend Legal review vendor remediation timeline once we have it. I'll loop them in after vendor replies.

maria: Summary actions:
- jason: vendor SLA & remediation ask (INF-4201)  Tue EOD
- aisha: registry fallback + sim + rollback (INF-4202)  next Mon
- don: auth hardening + alerts + digest (INF-4203)  10d

Please create tickets if not already in the epic and update status. We'll review in ops sync Friday.
